
---
title: "Lung Cancer Classification Using Gene Expression"
author: "Gauri Agrawal"
date: "2025-12-25"
output: html_document
---
```{r full-analysis, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Load required libraries
library(MASS)   # For Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA)

## 1. Load Lung Cancer Gene Expression Data

lung_cancer <- read.table("Data/09_lung_cancer.txt", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)

# Inspect sample names
colnames(lung_cancer)

## 2. Create Class Labels and Final Data Matrix
class_labels <- factor(c(
rep("Adeno", 10),
rep("SCLC", 9),
rep("Normal", 5)
))

lung_cancer_t <- t(lung_cancer)                                     # Transpose expression matrix so samples are rows
final_data <- data.frame(class = class_labels, lung_cancer_t)       # Combine class labels with expression data
dim(final_data)                                                     # Check dimensions


## 3. Split Data into Training and Test Sets

# Identify indices for each class
adeno_idx  <- which(final_data$class == "Adeno")
sclc_idx   <- which(final_data$class == "SCLC")
normal_idx <- which(final_data$class == "Normal")

# Training set: selected samples from each class
train_idx <- c(adeno_idx[1:6], sclc_idx[1:6], normal_idx[1:3])
training_set <- final_data[train_idx, ]

# Test set: remaining samples
test_idx <- setdiff(1:nrow(final_data), train_idx)
test_set <- final_data[test_idx, ]

# Save true class labels for evaluation
test_classes <- test_set$class

# Remove class column from test predictors
test_set <- test_set[, -1]


## 4. LDA Using First Two Genes Only

# Train LDA model using only the first two genes
lda_model_2g <- lda(class ~ ., data = training_set[, c(1, 2, 3)])

# Predict class labels for test samples
output_2g <- predict(lda_model_2g, test_set[, 1:2])

# Confusion matrix
confusion_2g <- table(Predicted = output_2g$class,
Actual = test_classes)
confusion_2g

#Misclassified samples:
sum(output_2g$class != test_classes)



## 5. Plot Discriminant Functions (First Two Genes)

# Extract discriminant scores
ld1 <- output_2g$x[,1]
ld2 <- output_2g$x[,2]

# Define colors for each class
cols <- c("Adeno" = "green", "SCLC" = "yellow", "Normal" = "black")
point_colors <- cols[test_classes]

# Plot LD1 vs LD2
plot(ld1, ld2,
col = point_colors,
pch = 19,
xlab = "LD1",
ylab = "LD2",
main = "LDA Classification Using First Two Genes")

# Add legend
legend("topright",
legend = names(cols),
col = cols,
pch = 19,
bty = "n")



## 6. LDA Using All Genes

# Train LDA model using all genes
lda_model_all <- lda(class ~ ., data = training_set)

# Predict test samples
output_all <- predict(lda_model_all, test_set)

# Confusion matrix
confusion_all <- table(Predicted = output_all$class,cActual = test_classes)
confusion_all

#Misclassified samples:
sum(output_all$class != test_classes)



## 7. Plot Discriminant Functions (All Genes)

# Extract discriminant scores
ld1_all <- output_all$x[,1]
ld2_all <- output_all$x[,2]

# Plot LD1 vs LD2
plot(ld1_all, ld2_all,
col = cols[test_classes],
pch = 19,
xlab = "LD1",
ylab = "LD2",
main = "LDA Classification Using All Genes")

# Add legend
legend("topright",
legend = names(cols),
col = cols,
pch = 19,
bty = "n")

```
